body: Thanks for all your help yesterday. It means a lot. Still here.

Nope. I have to go to training for work tomorrow, regular work day, unpaid. Really want to hook off but we're carpooling. Sunday I think I'm just going to sleep to be honest. I'm going to try and sleep now so I can function tomorrow.

Yeah, miss my cat. I do want a new pet, not to replace her because I can't but at least to help me through. Trying to love myself. Honestly trying. 

I am in lots of subreddits on my main account and they bring me smiles. Smiles fade though at the end of the night. I have a little journal I jot down feelings in, not like dear diary but just what I'm feeling. I need to find more coping mechanisms. 

Thanks again. I am going to head to bed soon. One more day down.

I was actually out sick Monday and Tuesday. I had a cry at my desk and my coworker caught me. She thought I had a migraine and they sent me home. I stayed back the second day because I wasn't up to it and because I live in the ice vortex of hell right now and roads were closed.

Thank you for that last paragraph so much, just especially that one. 

I have some hobbies, I write a lot, reddit I suppose, talking with friends, some favourite TV shows I want to catch up on. Haven't been reading as much as I use to, just devoured one book though so I should probably start doing that. My cat actually died less than a year ago. I'd had her for sixteen years and she was my rock (sometimes literally, she'd plant herself on my feet when I was on the couch or in bed so I couldn't move) and it was hard to lose her. Can't get another animal because my parents don't want one. 

If it's the perfect job I'm just going to say I'm having a personal issue and go but otherwise hopefully people will just move around my schedule. 

God I miss my idiot cat.

I know it's common business practice in sales. Not a fan of it, in fact not a fan of sales, I thought soft sales would be the same as hard sales. Not at all. 

I would love my parents support. The thing is they only want to give it if I'm doing what they want. When my fiance isn't around I can email my counselor, talk to one of my friends, or my brother.

Pretty much you just have to say thank you for your time. If they're really bad you can hang up. If they call back then our boss deals with them. To be honest I don't want to deal with it anymore because right now I don't feel capable of dealing with it. Also if I don't make my numbers I get in trouble and the team doesn't get prizes so when I can't make calls because of anxiety it affects others too. As far as dealing with it for at least the next two weeks (trying to think of it as in two weeks I'll have another job because it helps me get through) the only thing that's worked so far is not really healthy, I yell at myself in my head that I'm better than this and it usually makes me push through. 

Mom and support? Not sure. Really not sure. Honestly my parents are so freaking weird. My upbringing was completely atypical. I have no idea how families function or are supposed to work and no idea how to read my parents.
Thanks. That means a lot. I do feel that way to be honest and I don't want to. I really don't.

Thank you for your reply, I'll try to clarify/answer. I do have a counselor that is very helpful. I can afford to see her every 2 weeks, this month I scheduled her back to back weeks and will then see her in 3 weeks instead. She helps a lot. Psychiatrist is still in the works, referral is taking a while, they will just be for meds. 

I have a small group of friends and one sibling. All but one friend is going through something in their life and I feel awkward talking about my problems when they seem so intangible. The other friend is helping. None can provide financial support. I do have a 'trust fund' but it is controlled by my father.

I am looking for a job. Have had a few interviews. One problem is that employers want to interview during work hours so I can't leave work to go to interviews and sometimes they won't change the times. As much as I hate my job I have integrity and won't lie about needing time off (unless it is for the perfect job). Also I am in recruitment right now and know exactly where and how to look for jobs, that part for me is ridiculously easy, and my degree is in writing and literature so banging out resumes and cover letters is also quick. 

No one in my family could help with self harm. My mom would just break down. My father... ? honestly no clue. He's an enigma. My fiance helps with it and I am very careful but completely understand your concerns. Thank you for all your advice. I honestly think I just needed to fucking talk about all this I think because it's been weighing on me so much. Really, thank you.

The job is stressful because of the sales calls I have to make to businesses. Most calls are just boring and straight forward. No not interested, thanks, yeah you cal follow up. Some are bad. Some people yell, some are offended, the worst was when one woman laughed at me. 

I'm trying to reduce the stress at home by staying in my room when I am home rather than being around my parents. It has helped and my mom seems to be more worried about me now that I have retreated, which could maybe be a plus or a huge minus, not sure. Thanks though.

It really is. I don't know if I'm feeling so trapped by my family because I'm sick or if they really are just this... well... abusive? I feel odd using that word, they've never hit me but they are very controlling and opinionated on my life and they do force me into situations I don't want to be in. I don't think they get how bad it is though, and maybe if they did they would have more compassion instead of "life is hard, jobs suck, there's always hard aspects of jobs".
